event.description: Union closest block-0 pre-attention norm scales 6 and 14
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 38 prior macro-attempts and 448 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0095/micro-0001 at 1672 parameters and 99.010000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0095/micro-0002 (discard, 98.780000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of block 0's pre-attention normalization scales: union coordinates 6 and 14, values 0.2085438818 and 0.2194991410 (difference 1.096e-02), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: attention-input scaling has local redundancy distinct from pre-FF normalization, preserving qualification at 1,671 parameters. It is more informative than the next scale union (difference 1.267e-02) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test; the two fixed-zero biases remain fixed. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
